label: Runner-pack rifle-8way locomotion (Mixamo skeleton)
_note: Runner-pack equivalent of gasp_lower_body.json. Uses rifle-8way slugs (mixamorig:* skeleton, runner_glb conversion). Selector logic in src/anim/locomotion.js (selectGaspLocomotion) is shared — same state IDs (walk_F, run_FL, sprint_F, crouch_idle, etc.), only the clip names differ. Hipfire `clip` plays the low-ready stance; `adsClip` is the aimed shoulder pose for the same direction (currently shared across directions because the rifle-8way pack only ships one aiming-idle variant; per-direction ADS is a polish pass).

thresholds._speedNote: Thresholds match tunables.move speeds (walkSpeed 5, sprintSpeed 7), NOT the clip authoring speeds. Default WASD movement (5 m/s) lands in the 'run' bucket (8-way arms-up clips, consistent across directions); sprint (7 m/s) stays in 'run' too but timeScale (speed/speedRef) drives a faster cadence (~1.4x) so it reads as a sprint without a separate clip set. ADS forces 'walk' regardless of speed (see selectGaspLocomotion). Previously walkMax 1.6 / runMax 3.5 were calibrated for older ~1.4/4.0 speeds, so every standing move fell into 'sprint' and walk/run cycles never played.

states._lrFlipNote: FL/FR/BL/BR clip refs are intentionally flipped (FL → -right, FR → -left). The selector returns body-relative sectors (FL = body's left), but Mixamo authors directional clips with the character moving toward their own left/right which renders mirror-flipped relative to body-local in this rig's coordinate convention. Same flip pattern as gasp_lower_body.json.
